brief: Concept: lean manufacturing andon lights and kanban cards (lean checks the machine and routes work to the cheapest runner). Colours: floor #f1f3f4 (ground), ink #1b1f22, steel #5c6670 (muted, check 4.5:1), kanban #ffffff (cards), andon-green #1e7f4f, andon-amber #c98a00 (non-text), amber-ink #8a5a00, andon-red #c62828. Type: headings "Barlow Semi Condensed" 600, body "Barlow" 400, commands "IBM Plex Mono". Wordmark: "lean" lowercase, Barlow Semi Condensed 600. Cover pattern: an andon stack - three discs in a column, plus satellites, built from radius tokens. Hero: "/lean <goal>", the README one-sentence purpose, action "Install lean"; link text for the blog post if README names it.
ruling: Voice rule 5 gets a real example line from the lean README (quote it, cite it), or remove the rule. The Cover SVG derivation comment is exactly 4 lines.
defects: /Users/ashrocket/ashcode/lean-skill/design-system/README.md, section ## Voice, rule 5 ("No hype. Do not promise savings that the repo does not measure."): the rule has no example line from the product. SPEC section 2 requires each Voice rule to carry a real example line.

/Users/ashrocket/ashcode/lean-skill/design-system/components/Cover/preview.html, lines 6-14 of the inline SVG derivation comment (starting "Derivation:"): the comment runs about seven content lines. SPEC requires a 4-line derivation comment at the top of the SVG.
